exposure: Serum concentrations of kynurenine (KYN), kynurenic acid (KYNA), and quinolinic acid (QUIN)
outcome: Association between KAT SNPs and PDS
Serum levels of KYN, KYNA, and QUIN in women with and without PDS
cohort: 360 Chinese women scheduled for cesarean delivery
finding: While the study found alterations in the kynurenine pathway in women with PDS, there was no significant association found between the eight tested KAT SNPs and PDS.
